department: Department of Civil and Industrial Engineering

deadline.value: No common admission date: departments advertise positions continuously, each open at least three weeks. Apply to an advertised position.
deadline.quote: The faculty has no common call or admission date, but calls are made continuously during the year. | The announcement shall be available locally and on the university's website at least three weeks before the application deadline

also.quote: Rather than apply for a doctoral programme, candidates must apply for an available doctoral position.

gre_subject.value: Not stated on the pages checked.

supervisor.value: Admission goes with an advertised position, and the principal supervisor prepares the study plan before admission.
supervisor.quote: The principal supervisor, in consultation with the professor responsible for doctoral studies (FUAP), is responsible for drawing up an initial individual study plan prior to admission.

also.quote: Rather than apply for a doctoral programme, candidates must apply for an available doctoral position.

funding.value: The department commits to four years of full-time funding at admission, mainly as an employed doctoral student.
funding.quote: When admitting doctoral students, the department therefore undertakes to provide funding for four years of full-time study at doctoral level. | The primary means of support for doctoral students awarded admission is employment as a doctoral student (a doctoral studentship).

entry_route.value: A master's degree, or 240 credits including 60 at master's level with a 15-credit project, plus subject credits: see notes.
entry_route.quote: completed a degree at the advanced level (Master’s level), or | completed course requirements of at least 240 credits, of which at least 60 credits are at the advanced level

also.quote: b) by other means, within or outside the country, acquired knowledge of mainly the same extent.

notes: A Swedish engineering master's degree or equivalent knowledge from any country.
